assets.caption: Figure 3.3 Roughness factors
assets.notes: Log-log chart showing relative roughness (epsilon/D) and corrections to Moody 3.2 vs nominal pipe size DN. Multiple diagonal lines for different pipe materials. Y-axis left: corrections to Moody 3.2; Y-axis right: relative roughness epsilon/D. X-axis: Nominal pipe size, DN (range ~25 to 750). Note below chart states roughness factor for smooth cement-lined pipe DN 400 and larger is 50 µm.
